probes: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'edge_bff' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.relname, string_agg(a.privilege_type, ',' ORDER BY a.privilege_type) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl, acldefault('r', c.relowner))) a WHERE n.nspname = 'edge_bff' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND a.grantee = 'edge_bff_runtime'::regrole GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.relname, CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END, string_agg(a.privilege_type, ',' ORDER BY a.privilege_type) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl, acldefault('r', c.relowner))) a WHERE n.nspname = 'edge_bff' AND c.relname IN ('screener_items', 'watchlist_items') AND a.grantee <> c.relowner AND a.grantee <> 'edge_bff_runtime'::regrole GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT m.rolname FROM pg_auth_members a JOIN pg_roles m ON m.oid = a.member WHERE a.roleid = 'edge_bff_runtime'::regrole ORDER BY 1
SELECT tablename, indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'edge_bff' AND tablename IN ('screener_items', 'watchlist_items') ORDER BY 1, 2
SELECT conrelid::regclass::text, conname, contype FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid IN ('edge_bff.screener_items'::regclass, 'edge_bff.watchlist_items'::regclass) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT c.relname, a.attname, col_description(c.oid, a.attnum) IS NOT NULL AS has_comment FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid WHERE n.nspname = 'edge_bff' AND c.relname = 'screener_items' AND a.attname IN ('definition', 'registry_version', 'screener_registry_version', 'definition_hash', 'revision') UNION ALL SELECT c.relname, '(table)', obj_description(c.oid, 'pg_class') IS NOT NULL FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'edge_bff' AND c.relname IN ('screener_items', 'watchlist_items') ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_table_privilege('edge_bff_runtime', c.oid, 'SELECT')) AS readable, count(*) AS relations FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.screener_items) AS screener_items, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.watchlist_items) AS watchlist_items
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.backtest_jobs) AS backtest_jobs, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.conversation_ui) AS conversation_ui
